name: Aquatic invertebrates
description: Aquatic insects, mites, snails and shrimps living in the river and on the flooded forest floor. Functional group aggregating the source's aquatic-invertebrate compartment - mites (superorder Acariformes), hemipteran and coleopteran insects, apple snails (Ampullariidae), chironomid midges, palaemonid shrimps and polymitarcyid mayflies.
